claims.text: MT-DNN incorporates multi-task deep neural network learning to learn representations across multiple natural language understanding tasks.
Multi-task representation learning provides a regularization effect that yields general representations adaptable to new tasks and domains.
MT-DNN achieves a score of 82.7% on the GLUE benchmark, representing a 2.2% absolute improvement.
MT-DNN learned representations enable domain adaptation with substantially fewer in-domain labels compared to pre-trained BERT representations on SNLI and SciTail datasets.

evidence.description: In this paper, we present a Multi-Task Deep Neural Network (MT-DNN) for learning representations across multiple natural language understanding (NLU) tasks.
...benefits from a regularization effect that leads to more general representations to help adapt to new tasks and domains.
...pushing the GLUE benchmark to 82.7% (2.2% absolute improvement).

We also demonstrate using the SNLI and Sc-iTail datasets that the representations learned by MT-DNN allow domain adaptation with substantially fewer in-domain labels than the pre-trained BERT representations.

methodologies.name: Multi-Task Deep Neural Network (MT-DNN)
methodologies.description: A multi-task deep neural network framework for learning representations across multiple natural language understanding tasks and adapting to new domains.
conditions: domain adaptation with few in-domain labels
